title: RVND MCP App surface card
description: One rendered surface in the RVND governance flow. A card renders server state; it never computes a verdict.

step.description: Which cycle step this card owns.

reads.description: The RVND operations (canonical verbs or live op names) this card reads from. A card computes no verdict of its own.

renders.description: What the card puts on screen.

status_vocabulary.description: Allowed status words for this card. The proposal card must exclude granted/enabled/active/in-effect.

mode.description: Decision-card mode. ratification renders approve/deny for a determinate verdict; residual-origination renders unranked alternatives and must never render as approve/reject.

decision_vocabulary.description: Allowed decision words for a decision card. A residual-origination card must exclude approve/deny/reject.

alternatives_min.description: For a residual-origination card: the minimum number of real, unranked alternatives (>= 2).

lamps.description: Discrete verdict/state lamps. No numeric scores or dials are permitted.

forbids_scores.description: Must be true: RVND surfaces render discrete lamps, never dials or scores.

attributed.description: Must be true: every outcome shown carries its rule, key, and (for loosening) approver.
